name: Fuuma Kotarou
source:
He is summoned as the "ninja reinforcement" who has come to the main character's castle. Originally served a neighboring country which was devastated by demons.

Moves like a shadow and possesses nearly inhuman techniques.

Somewhat of a loner, and dislikes groups. He dislikes being held back by rules imposed on him by others and lives a free and unrestrained life.

[From in-game profile]
